target.summary: When clearing a selection, clear() invokes clickPillClearButtons() whenever pills are present. On combo boxes configured with singleSelection, pills are rendered without close buttons, causing the locator to hang and time out.
notes: faulty statement unconditionally calling clickPillClearButtons when pills are present
definition of the method whose behavior is wrong
call site relying on faulty clear() method
definition of helper that assumes pills have close buttons
